title: PoppyBrowserSessionAuthorize
description: The JSON body a Personal Agent posts to {browser_session_endpoint}/authorize, with the Session header and, if signed in, its access token, to authorize the one-time code from the browser-session page (spec 6, step 2). The Company responds with HTTP 204, or 400 with invalid_request for a code that is unknown, expired, or already authorized.
